car_dubins_path — GRAPH path op

• Data kinds: matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.car_dubins_path(poses, radius=1.0, step=0.05) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import carpath; carpath.car_dubins_path(poses, radius=1.0, step=0.05), registry से लेना हो तो opsgraph.get("car_dubins_path"))

उपयोग

दो poses के बीच केवल आगे चलने वाली car का shortest path (Dubins 1957), छह closed-form words से।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

poses is [[x, y, theta], [x', y', theta']] (start, goal; theta in radians, counter-clockwise from the x axis). The car turns with minimum radius radius and never reverses. Dubins proved the shortest path is one of LSL, RSR, LSR, RSL, RLR, LRL (arcs of maximal curvature and straights); each word's three segment lengths are closed-form (Shkel and Lumelsky 2001). Every candidate is verified by forward integration to the goal and discarded if it misses (fail-closed against formula slips; the count is returned as n_rejected), and the shortest survivor is the answer.

Returns word, length (metres), segments [(kind, gear, length)] (kind L/S/R, gear +1), points (N, 3) poses sampled every step metres along the path (start and goal included), candidates [(word, length)] for all verified words in increasing length, n_rejected, lower_bound (the Euclidean distance, never exceeded), radius.

Raises ValueError: poses not (2, 3) finite; radius or step not positive; no word reaches the goal (cannot happen for finite poses; reported rather than guessed).
